blurb: Guests sail aboard the Friendship Sloop Kestrel to explore Portland Harbor, lighthouses, historic forts, and wildlife. The company offers day sails and sunset sails with options for private charters. The vessel is eco-friendly with a fully electric engine and accommodates up to 6 passengers.
